entries.prompt: Heavy metal vault door unsealing: deep mechanical clunks, hydraulic hiss, single dramatic clang as it unlocks, then a low resonant boom. Cinematic, slightly futuristic, family-friendly tone.
entries.description: Plays when the Password Vault door swings open at the end of all 5 locks active.

entries.prompt: Magical treasure-chamber reveal: cascading bell chimes, ethereal shimmer, soft choir swell, ascending sparkle. Warm, awe-inspiring, kid-friendly fantasy.
entries.description: Plays when the vault interior treasure chamber becomes visible (the shield core + artifacts).

entries.prompt: Playful sticker landing: quick paper-fluttering whoosh, light pop, tiny celebratory chime. Snappy, cute, ~half second.
entries.description: Plays as each individual sticker lands on its shelf in StickerUnlock.

entries.prompt: Triumphant boss defeat stinger: ascending heroic fanfare, victory bells, descending raccoon-like grumble of defeat, bright crystalline finale. Family-friendly, not scary.
entries.description: Plays when the Hacker Raccoon is defeated at the end of the boss battle.

entries.prompt: Golden badge unlock: warm bell-like resonance with shimmer wash, soft heraldic flourish, glowing finale chord. Reward-feel, satisfying, ~1.5 seconds.
entries.description: Plays when the badge appears in the Mission Complete / completion ceremony.

entries.prompt: Heroic mission briefing sting: brief warm fanfare, ascending chord with light percussion, sparkle finish. Inviting and adventurous, family-friendly, ~1.4 seconds.
entries.description: Plays on the Mission Brief screen (screen 1) to mark the start of the lesson.

entries.prompt: Welcoming chamber entrance: soft door-open swoosh, magical entryway swell, distant bell chimes, warm ambient bloom. Friendly, slightly mystical, kid-safe, ~2.5 seconds.
entries.description: Plays once when the Cyber HQ page (/cyberhq) is opened.

entries.prompt: Triumphant mission-complete fanfare: bright golden brass chord resolving into a warm major cadence, shimmering bell tail. Celebratory, family-friendly, ~2.5 seconds.
entries.description: Plays on the final completion screen (screen 22) when the badge ceremony lands.
